description: This file is a test class for the LeavePeriodHistoryService in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It contains multiple unit tests to verify the behavior of leave period generation logic, including configurations, leap year handling, and date-based retrieval functions.

classes.name: LeavePeriodHistoryServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for LeavePeriodHistoryService, testing various leave period computations and configurations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment and sets up the leavePeriodService with fixtures.

methods.name: testGetGeneratedLeavePeriodListDateIsNotSet
methods.description: Tests that an exception is thrown when start date is not set in leave period history.

methods.name: testGetGeneratedLeavePeriodListDefineAs2012Jan1st
methods.description: Verifies leave period generation starting from Jan 1, 2012.

methods.name: testGetGeneratedLeavePeriodListDefineAs2010Jan1st
methods.description: Verifies leave period generation starting from Jan 1, 2010.

methods.name: xtestGetGeneratedLeavePeriodListForLeapYear
methods.description: (Disabled test) intended to test leap year handling for leave period generation.

methods.name: testGetGeneratedLeavePeriodListDefineAs2010Jan1stAnd2012Jan1st
methods.description: Tests multiple history entries to verify leave periods across multiple years.

methods.name: xtestGetGeneratedLeavePeriodListCase1
methods.description: (Disabled test) tests leave period generation over a span of multiple historical dates.

methods.name: testGetCurrentLeavePeriodByDate
methods.description: Verifies the correct leave period retrieved for specific dates.

methods.name: convertLeavePeriodArrayToYmdArray
methods.description: Helper to convert array of LeavePeriod objects to array of start-end date strings.

methods.name: convertLeavePeriodToArray
methods.description: Helper to convert a single LeavePeriod object to an array of start and end dates.

methods.name: getLastDayInFebruary
methods.description: Returns the last day of February for a given year, accounting for leap years.
